title: UPSC Engineering Services Mains Admit Card 2026
intro: Short Information : Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the mains admit card for the post of Engineering Service Examination 2026 on the official website of UPSC. This recruitment was released for 474 posts. Applications for the UPSC Engineering Services Recruitment 2025 were accepted from September 26, 2025, to October 16, 2025. The mains is going to be conducted on 21 June 2026. 08 February 2025. Candidates who had qualified for this pre examination can download their UPSC Engineering Services Mains Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.
applicationFee: Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
